title: WMAP 微波異向性探測
summary: 由差分觀測重建小型天空圖，辨識不可觀測的共同常數與閉合殘差。
summaryEn: Reconstruct a small sky map from differences and identify the unobservable common offset and closure residual.
scope: 本課採用原創紙面、試算表或離線模型練習。案例來源用於查證背景；數值、擾動及驗收門檻是明示的教學假設，不是設備規格、製程配方、臨床操作或飛行程序。實作成果是可重算的分析紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original paper, spreadsheet, or offline-model exercises. References establish case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and acceptance limits are stated teaching assumptions, not equipment specifications, production recipes, clinical instructions, or flight procedures. Deliver reproducible analysis records.

WMAP 量測天空各方向宇宙微波背景的溫度差。
optionsEn: Nonzero closure indicates noise or calibration inconsistency;forcing one difference to close hides the anomaly.
State the zero-point constraint and assess all residuals;absolute offset requires information beyond the difference map.
WMAP measured cosmic-microwave-background temperature differences across the sky.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「案例與來源邊界」。WMAP 量測天空各方向宇宙微波背景的溫度差。 與本階段判準一起判讀：反向邊數值反號，不能混用 A−B 與 B−A。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. WMAP measured cosmic-microwave-background temperature differences across the sky. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Reversing an edge reverses its sign.

knowledge.title: 物理模型與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 差分資料只限制像素間差值；所有像素同加常數不改觀測，需選定零點約束。
knowledge.textEn: Differences constrain relative pixel values;adding one constant to all pixels leaves observations unchanged,so a zero-point constraint is needed.

quiz.question: 「差分觀測圖」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Differential observation graph: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: C=0、B=20、A=30 μK；閉合和 10+20−30=0 μK。選 C=0 不代表真實絕對天空溫度。
交付有向圖、零點定義、重建值及閉合殘差，保留原始差分。
閉合不為零表示噪聲或校準不一致；任意把一條差值改到閉合會隱藏異常。
optionsEn: C=0,B=20,A=30 μK;closure sum is zero. C=0 is a gauge,not an absolute sky-temperature measurement.
Deliver directed graph,gauge,reconstructed values and closure residuals while retaining raw differences.
Nonzero closure indicates noise or calibration inconsistency;forcing one difference to close hides the anomaly.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。閉合不為零表示噪聲或校準不一致；任意把一條差值改到閉合會隱藏異常。 與本階段判準一起判讀：反向邊數值反號，不能混用 A−B 與 B−A。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. Nonzero closure indicates noise or calibration inconsistency;forcing one difference to close hides the anomaly. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Reversing an edge reverses its sign.

steps.title: 差分觀測圖 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Differential observation graph · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「差分觀測圖」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Differential observation graph and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
閉合不為零表示噪聲或校準不一致；任意把一條差值改到閉合會隱藏異常。
對照「差分觀測圖」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。先記錄零點約束，再以全部殘差驗收；共同偏置須依額外資料而非差分圖本身求得。
本階段必須重驗：反向邊數值反號，不能混用 A−B 與 B−A。
steps.instructionEn:
Nonzero closure indicates noise or calibration inconsistency;forcing one difference to close hides the anomaly.
Against the nominal Differential observation graph result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. State the zero-point constraint and assess all residuals;absolute offset requires information beyond the difference map.
Reverify this criterion: Reversing an edge reverses its sign.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。閉合不為零表示噪聲或校準不一致；任意把一條差值改到閉合會隱藏異常。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Nonzero closure indicates noise or calibration inconsistency;forcing one difference to close hides the anomaly.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 反向邊數值反號，不能混用 A−B 與 B−A。
steps.checkEn: Reversing an edge reverses its sign.

quiz.question: 「差分觀測圖」：哪一項提供依證據採取處置或重新驗證的條件？
quiz.questionEn: Differential observation graph: Which statement gives the evidence-based disposition or re-verification condition?
options: 差分資料只限制像素間差值；所有像素同加常數不改觀測，需選定零點約束。
先記錄零點約束，再以全部殘差驗收；共同偏置須依額外資料而非差分圖本身求得。
WMAP 量測天空各方向宇宙微波背景的溫度差。
optionsEn: Differences constrain relative pixel values;adding one constant to all pixels leaves observations unchanged,so a zero-point constraint is needed.
State the zero-point constraint and assess all residuals;absolute offset requires information beyond the difference map.
WMAP measured cosmic-microwave-background temperature differences across the sky.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「處置與重新驗證」。先記錄零點約束，再以全部殘差驗收；共同偏置須依額外資料而非差分圖本身求得。 與本階段判準一起判讀：反向邊數值反號，不能混用 A−B 與 B−A。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies disposition and re-verification. State the zero-point constraint and assess all residuals;absolute offset requires information beyond the difference map. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Reversing an edge reverses its sign.

steps.title: 差分觀測圖 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Differential observation graph · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「差分觀測圖」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Differential observation graph and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付有向圖、零點定義、重建值及閉合殘差，保留原始差分。
在交接件中加入「差分觀測圖」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：反向邊數值反號，不能混用 A−B 與 B−A。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：由差分觀測重建小型天空圖，辨識不可觀測的共同常數與閉合殘差。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver directed graph,gauge,reconstructed values and closure residuals while retaining raw differences.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Differential observation graph: Reversing an edge reverses its sign.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Reconstruct a small sky map from differences and identify the unobservable common offset and closure residual. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。反向邊數值反號，不能混用 A−B 與 B−A。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Reversing an edge reverses its sign.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 反向邊數值反號，不能混用 A−B 與 B−A。
steps.checkEn: Reversing an edge reverses its sign.
